biggest_catch: Only for students 18+ enrolled in school — not open to general adult poll workers; full day runs 6:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m.
catches: Students only: must be 18+ and enrolled in school with administrator permission.
Very long full day: 6:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. (16 hours) for $250.
Must schedule, attend, and pass the required training class before working.
Training-class pay not stated on the form.

steps: Be 18+ and enrolled in school, residing in the District of Columbia.
Get permission from a school administrator and complete the Adult Student Election Worker application.
Be contacted by DC BOE to schedule the training class; attend and pass it.
Work the selected shift on Election Day: full day 6:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. ($250) or half day 7:00 a.m.-3:00 p.m. ($125).
timing: Election-day only (full or half-day shift) plus required training class beforehand.
